purpose.sw: Rekodi za matibabu ya wazi (EHR) — wagonjwa, mahudhurio, dawa.
purpose.en: Open medical records (EHR) — patients, encounters, orders.

integration.note_sw: REST module ya OpenMRS inatoa API ya wagonjwa na encounters.

purpose.sw: Information system ya maabara (LIMS) — sampuli na majibu.
purpose.en: Laboratory information system (LIMS) — samples and results.

purpose.sw: Takwimu za afya kwa ngazi zote (HMIS) — ripoti na dashibodi.
purpose.en: Health information stats (HMIS) — reporting and dashboards.

integration.note_sw: Web API ya DHIS2 kwa data elements na analytics.

purpose.sw: Interop layer (HIE) — inaunganisha mifumo ya afya kwa salama.
purpose.en: Interop layer (HIE) — securely routes between health systems.

integration.note_sw: Mediator ndogo inayozungumza na gateway ya MTAALAMU.

purpose.sw: Zana ya EHR ya wazi — msingi wa kliniki na hospitali ndogo.
purpose.en: Open EHR toolkit — base for clinics and small hospitals.

integration.note_sw: API ya REST kwa wagonjwa na data ya kliniki.

purpose.sw: EHR kamili yenye billing na FHIR API — tayari kwa kliniki.
purpose.en: Full EHR with billing and FHIR API — clinic ready.

integration.note_sw: FHIR API ya OpenEMR kwa uhamishaji wa data.

purpose.sw: Mfumo wa hospitali kwa maeneo yenye internet hafifu (offline-first).

integration.note_sw: Sync ya offline inafaa maeneo yenye mtandao dhaifu.

purpose.sw: Hospitali kamili ya wazi (OpenMRS + Odoo) — dawa, maabara, bima.
purpose.en: Full open hospital (OpenMRS + Odoo) — meds, lab, billing.

integration.note_sw: Inaunganisha OpenMRS na Odoo kwa mzunguko kamili wa hospitali.

purpose.sw: Nishati mbadala ya vifaa vya kliniki (solar charge controller ya wazi).
purpose.en: Alternative power for clinic devices (open solar charge controller).

integration.note_sw: Marejeo ya hardware kwa shughuli za FUNDI.
